decision: cd-setup-plan.md section 10 (D12, review findings F13/F14); directive f9-01 item 3; lead decisions O1-A and O3 (2026-10-21)
rules: Every path of the Setup CD boot image belongs to exactly one component: the row with the longest matching path entry (an entry ending in '/' is a directory prefix, one ending in '*' a name prefix, any other entry one exact path). A path without a row fails the build (fails closed).

A component is present when at least one CD path belongs to it. Every archive listed by a present component must be produced and hash-checked, whatever its class; a copyleft component without its archives fails the build (GPLv2 section 3(a): source on the same medium; no recorded-reason tolerance).
A bundled-shareware row needs its conditions text; every package of the games manifest (build-manifest.json games.packages) needs a row naming it.
Archives go to \SOURCES on the ISO; licence texts to \LICENSES with \LICENSES\INDEX.TXT and \LICENSES\SOURCES.TXT.

excluded.third_party/games/: shareware data, not source; the games manifest keeps the DOOM DMFAQ66* files out of every medium
excluded.third_party/drivers/: third-party driver binaries without a redistribution grant; not a build input of the Setup CD
excluded.third_party/DOSNavigator/, third_party/c: 0.8-line or optional inputs not shipped in the F0 payload; the FreeDOS reference ships its own pinned packages below
excluded.tests/, docs/ (except docs/licenses/), d: not needed to rebuild the shipped binaries

FDKERNEL.ZIP.describes: FreeDOS 1.3 kernel package (binaries and SOURCE/KERNEL/SOURCES.ZIP) for the FreeDOS reference image and its SYS boot sector
